section.content: 通过从具有预定周期的第一时钟中消除一些脉冲产生作为间歇脉冲链的第二时钟，并将其作为内部时钟提供给半导体集成电路设备的内部电路。同时，用于消耗电源电流的电流产生电路与第三时钟时间关联地工作，所述第三时钟包括待从所述第一时钟中消除的脉冲链。

A second clock is generated as an intermittent train of pulses by removing some pulses from a first clock having a predetermined period, and is supplied as an internal clock to internal circuits of a semiconductor integrated circuit device. At the same time, a current generating circuit for consuming a power supply current is operated in timed relation to a third clock which comprises a train of pulses to be removed from the first clock.

Semiconductor integrated circuit apparatusBackground of invention

Technical field

The present invention relates to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus, it has a plurality of operationally synchronous with internal clocking internal circuits.

Background technology

In recent years, the many semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus such as microcomputer or the like have the various internal circuits of being made up of CMOS (complementary metal oxide semiconductor (CMOS)), and described CMOS is helpful for highly integrated design and low-power consumption.When the output of cmos circuit changes to " 0 " or changes to " 1 " from " 0 " from " 1 ", cmos circuit electric consumption electric current.Specifically, if semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus has the bus line that is connected to big capacitive load, and drive by cmos circuit, when then the data on the described bus line change to " 0 " or change to " 1 " from " 0 " from " 1 ", a large amount of electric currents of described semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus consumption.This means: by the semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus consumed current, can read in the data processing sequence of carrying out in the semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus by observation, and the data of in this semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus, handling.That is to say, by observing in the variation aspect the semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus consumed current, perhaps, people can discern just what data of transmission on this bus line, how this semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus works, and what data this semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus is handling.Therefore, need such technology, be used for making in fact can not being kept at user program and internal data in the semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus whereby based on data are reproduced in the observation of institute's consumed current waveform.

A kind of classic method that is used to protect user program and internal data is that such user program and internal data are encrypted.For example, Jap.P. discloses a kind of pseudorandom number generator No. 2937919, is used to produce the random number for program and data encryption use.

According to a kind of simple process process that reduces current sinking waveform data correlativity, has any spurious current of the predetermined period of the data variation of not relying on all the time to the semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus supply.

Yet, owing to all the time the electric current of the falseness of its supply has been increased by described by the semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus consumed current, so semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus is restricted in its application facet.In addition, the ability of the described treatment progress that is used for defence program and internal data is relatively low, and this is because can decide the existence of any spurious current by the observation to the current waveform that consumes.

Summary of the invention

Therefore; an object of the present invention is to provide a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus; it makes the observation be difficult to based on to the current waveform that consumes reproduce the data of being preserved under the situation of the electric current that exceedingly do not increase consumption, and has increased the ability of defence program and internal data whereby.

To achieve these goals, a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus according to the present invention has intermittently clock generation circuit, this circuit is by eliminating some pulses from first clock with predetermined period, produce second clock, and described second clock is offered each internal circuit of semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus as internal clocking as the intermittent pulse chain.Simultaneously, the current generating circuit that is used for the electric consumption electric current is worked with the 3rd clock time relatedly, and described the 3rd clock comprises the pulse train of eliminating from first clock.

Utilize said structure,, change the waveform of the current sinking of semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus with the same mode when using first clock normally to work when internal circuit even internal circuit is to use second clock work.

Therefore, the current sinking waveform that is difficult to observe when being to use second clock work when internal circuit, the current sinking waveform of observation is distinguished mutually with being to use first clock normally to work when internal circuit when.Correspondingly, even, also be difficult to reproduce just in processed data processing sequence (program) and internal data by analyzing the current sinking waveform.Being kept at the program in the semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus and the ability of internal data has been increased.In addition, prevented that current sinking from having unnecessary increase, this is because needn't supply any spurious current all the time to semiconductor integrated circuit apparatus all the time.
